title: Resolve manual checklist conflict with strict sender matching intact
public_pr_body:
Resolve #183's tests/MANUAL-CHECKS.md conflict with current main. Keep the explicit fractional-penny example (1.005) and main's strict rule that plus-addresses must match exactly. Remove the obsolete provenance sentence that claimed the contrary address rule. All other manual checks are retained.

Base: codex/manual-checks. Main is merged locally on this new branch; merge-tree confirms the resulting head merges cleanly with main 787ba18. No SQL applied and no docs-directory changes. Validation: checklist content reviewed, both required safety checks asserted present, obsolete stripping instruction absent, whitespace checks passed. Live manual/browser checks were not executed.
